thread:
maria: Hey RFC reviewers — quick runbook for Thu RFC sync. Need to finalize ordering + author slots. Two authors want the same slot (Alex & Priya). Thoughts? Also can reviewers confirm availability? Agenda draft:
1) optimize pipeline (Priya)
2) infra deploy rfc (Alex)
3) runtime tweak (Timo)
Pre-read PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/rfcs/123

ben: I can take the early slot if needed. Can move my review time.

alex: I actually prefer afternoon; @priya did you request morning? @sam can you review infra?

priya: Morning is tight but I can swap — 11:00 works for me (prefers earlier than 11:30)

sam: I can review infra; might be 5 min late though.

jordan: +1 to putting optimize first — there's a small overlap with infra so better to do optimize first and then infra follow-up. Left a couple comments on the PRs.

maria: Proposal: 10:45 Priya (opt), 11:15 Alex (infra), 11:45 Timo (runtime). Reviewers: @ben -> optimize, @sam -> infra, @jordan -> runtime. Objections?

ben: available :thumbsup:

sam: available, will be +5

timo: works for me. I'll cut slides to 3m and have demo ready.

dev-bot: Calendar invite updated and sent to #eng. Meeting link: https://meet.example/abc123

maria: Thanks — unless I hear objections by EOD I'll lock these slots. Also please add a 'Compatibility notes' header to PRs so reviewers can scan fast.

alex: added compat notes in the PR now.

priya: uploading slides by 6pm.

maria: tagging reviewers again: @sam @ben @jordan please give a quick thumbs if you've scanned pre-reads.

sam: :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

jordan: looked, couple nits but fine for slot.

maria: Great — locking slots. See you all Thu. :calendar:
